skills.name: ngu-form
skills.description: Write, change or debug Angular forms built with ngu-form (defineForm specs rendered by <ngu-form>). Use whenever the project depends on ngu-form or the user asks for a form in an Angular app that has it installed.

skills.name: ngu-form-from-image
skills.description: Recreate a form from a screenshot, photo, mockup or design export with ngu-form, then render it and compare it with the image. Use when the user shares an image of a form, a wizard, a settings page or any data-entry screen and asks to build it in an Angular app that has ngu-form.
